<contract name="calder.md">
# Calder Tools — SpecTrack 5 Subscription (fictional excerpt)

## Term
This subscription runs from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2027 and does not renew automatically. A new order form is required to continue service.

## Termination for Convenience
Customer may terminate for convenience on sixty (60) days written notice; prepaid fees for the remainder of the current year are not refunded.

## Fees
Fees are fixed for the term.

## Data
Customer may export requirements, links, and history in ReqIF format at any time during the term.
</contract>
